description: Default flag type registry for Phase 1. Shipped with plugin.

flag_types.message: Organization has no ethics policy URL in metadata
flag_types.remediation_guidance: Add an ethics policy URL to your site metadata or WordPress settings, following Trust Project recommendations: https://trustproject.org/
flag_types.eval_condition: ethics_policy_url is null AND editorial_standards_url is null

flag_types.message: Image has no creator attribution in metadata or C2PA manifest
flag_types.remediation_guidance: Add photographer credit via the sidebar 'Creator Name' field, or ensure the image includes EXIF artist metadata from the camera or editing software.

flag_types.message: Image has no source attribution and no C2PA provenance chain
flag_types.remediation_guidance: Add source attribution via the sidebar, or ensure the image has C2PA signing or ingredient references showing its origin.
flag_types.eval_condition: source_attribution is null AND provenance_chain_depth is 0

flag_types.message: Image capture method is unknown (no C2PA actions or EXIF metadata)
flag_types.remediation_guidance: This is informational. Many legitimate images lack method metadata. For valuable investigative work, consider adding method metadata or C2PA signing.
flag_types.eval_condition: capture_method is 'unknown' AND no C2PA actions

flag_types.message: Organization has no stated diversity commitment in metadata
flag_types.remediation_guidance: Add a diversity commitment URL to your site metadata, or refer to your organization's diversity and inclusion initiatives.

flag_types.message: Organization has no feedback mechanism or corrections process URL
flag_types.remediation_guidance: Publish contact information or a corrections form, and link to it in your site metadata.
flag_types.eval_condition: feedback_mechanism_url is null AND corrections_process_url is null

flag_types.message: Image does not have a C2PA manifest
flag_types.remediation_guidance: This is informational. C2PA manifests are optional but provide valuable provenance data. Consider ORing images with C2PA signing when possible.

flag_types.message: Image has a C2PA manifest but it failed validation
flag_types.remediation_guidance: The manifest may be corrupted or improperly signed. Re-sign the image or use a fresh source. Contact technical support if the issue persists.
flag_types.eval_condition: c2pa_manifest_present is true and c2pa_manifest_valid is false
